$comment: The delivered Thmanyah files, pinned by sha256 (MUT-102, ADR-058). The licence forbids any modification (no subsetting, no woff2), so a changed hash is a licence problem, not a refresh. brand.test.ts checks src/assets/fonts holds exactly these; scripts/check-bundles.ts checks every dist ships them byte-identical. Re-pin only when Thmanyah's official files replace these: the two Serif Display files are byte-identical to the copies MUT-105 flags as third-party, so they are due to be re-downloaded from Thmanyah's official site and re-pinned once (TD-085).
